situations.headline: MSI AGM: pending sale of Superstructures unit, Forgings interest queued, new NATO defence contract with 2027 delivery

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: MSI AGM: pending sale of Superstructures unit, Forgings interest queued, new NATO defence contract with 2027 delivery (interest 5, risk 3)

thesis.text: MSI is mid-transition: divesting non-core Petrol Station Superstructures/Branding (process ongoing, no firm date) [uk:9763395 p.1], with Forgings sale interest queued behind it [uk:9763395 p.1], while its Defence and Security segment wins new multi-year contracts (NATO country, 2027 delivery) [uk:9763395 p.1] amid a strong but delay-prone order pipeline [uk:9763395 p.1]. Catalyst path: (1) Superstructures sale announcement, (2) subsequent Forgings monetisation, (3) defence order conversion tied to rising NATO budgets and UK fiscal signals from the October budget [uk:9763395 p.1]. Track as event-driven divestiture optionality layered on a re-rating defence order book; re-underwrite once sale terms or budget-linked order flow are disclosed.
